subject: Pilot credits & pricing — follow-up and extension request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credits & pricing — follow-up and next steps

Hi Alyssa — great to meet (virtually) earlier. Quick recap from today’s discovery and proposed next steps: 

Summary of the call:
- Primary use case: clinical-note summarization + internal QA/triage.
- Expected traffic: 1.2M–2.5M tokens per week during pilot peak (approx 5–10M tokens/month).
- Current pilot burn: ~1.1M tokens/week (backend staging).
- Success metrics: 90% reduction in manual triage time; latency under 800ms P95 for production requests.

Cost/pricing notes we discussed:
- Target unit economics you mentioned: ~$900–$1,200 per 1M tokens (you asked if we can get to ~$900).
- Our standard pilot unit: hosted credits + recommended batching/quant. We can publish expected $/1M based on the model / quantization you select — I’ll include a short estimate below.

Ask / next steps:
1) Can you confirm expected steady-state burn during the next 2 weeks (tokens/day or tokens/week)? The screenshot you pulled into the staging dashboard would help.
2) We can approve a short credits extension while you ramp — please confirm the length (2 weeks vs 4 weeks) and expected burn so I can get approval from Sales Ops.
3) If procurement needs paperwork, I’ve attached the pilot-credits-terms.pdf.

Preliminary unit-economics estimate (example):
- Model: redwood-2-small (quantized) => estimated $1,050 per 1M tokens
- With extra batching/kv-cache we'll probably land closer to $850–$950 per 1M tokens at your expected latencies (confirm model & seq lengths to refine).

I’ll propose an internal approval for $5k in credits (roughly ~5–6M tokens at the mid estimate) if you want a 2‑week runway. If you need a 4‑week extension we’d look to scope and approvals. 

Attachments: pilot-credits-terms.pdf (summary of pilot terms & usage expectations)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15-min sync if it helps.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@acmehealth.com>

Subject: Re: Pilot credits & pricing — follow-up and next steps

Thanks Marissa — really helpful recap. Quick answers below: 

- Confirmed pilot burn: last 7 days averaged 1.0–1.3M tokens/week; our projected ramp (when we flip a few more teams) is ~1.8–2.4M tokens/week. I’ve attached a dashboard screenshot (acme-usage-screenshot.png).
- Procurement: we’ll need a short credit agreement and an approval note for the procurement file; your pilot-credits-terms.pdf looks fine but procurement will ask for an invoice-ready line item.
- Budget: our leadership gave a working target of $900/1M tokens for the pilot evaluation window — if you can hit that we’re in a much better place to move to a paid pilot.

We’d like to request a 2-week extension of credits (to cover the ramp), with the ask that Redwood provide up to $5,000 in hosting credits. Can you confirm and send whatever your team needs to sign?

Also: is there any scope to narrow the unit economics by adjusting model size / quantization? If we can trade off a small increase in latency for a better $/1M that would be acceptable.

Thanks —
Alyssa
Director, AI Product — Acme Health
alyssa@acmehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0133
